body:
China ​is expected to allow refiners to export steady volumes of refined fuel this month versus August, enabling ‌them to profit from higher overseas margins as Beijing continues to ease export controls, five trade sources briefed on the matter said.

Crude oil tanker in Zhoushan

Bond prices continued to slide pushing borrowing costs to multi-decade highs.

Illustration shows U.S. dollar, Euro, Yen, Pound, Turkish Lira, Yuan banknotes [...] Gold bounced from a near one-month low on Wednesday as the ‌U.S. dollar and Treasury yields retreated from recent highs, while investors awaited U.S. payrolls data due later this week for cues on the Federal Reserve's policy path.

A view of smelted gold bars at a smelting facility in Accra, Ghana

Shares of Shein slipped more ​than 3% on Wednesday, a day after a ‌lacklustre debut session following a long-awaited initial public offering. [...] Susquehanna International Group ‌plans to triple its office space in Hong Kong to support a major hiring push, four sources said, as the U.S. trading firm expands Asia operations and seeks deeper access to China's exchange-traded fund (ETF) market.

A general view of skyline buildings, in Hong Kong

Shares and bonds staged a relief rally in Asia on Thursday ​while the yen added to gains as investors awaited fresh U.S. data and central banker comments for signals that could ‌determine whether the Federal Reserve tightens policy this month.

A man walks past a stock quotation board showing the  Nikkei stock prices outside a brokerage in Tokyo
